title: Penstock project configuration
description: Configuration for Penstock. A file in a subfolder overrides the one above it, penstock.local.yaml overrides the file beside it, the active profile overrides both, and PENSTOCK_* environment variables have the last word.

engine.description: Which engine the diagrams target. Decides the palette, the properties panel and what deploy does.

scriptType.description: Default language for script tasks. Camunda 7, Operaton and CIB seven only.

elementTemplates.description: Folders and files to read Camunda element templates from, relative to the project root. .camunda/element-templates next to a diagram or in any folder above it is read without being listed.

linked.description: Other repositories that belong to this project, relative to its root: the workers, delegates and diagrams in them count as part of it. A path that is not checked out is skipped.

palette.description: The elements the BPMN palette offers, for a project that uses only some of them. The tools (hand, lasso, space, connect) always stay. Without it the whole palette is shown.

lint.description: Which bpmnlint rules the check and penstock lint apply. Without it, .bpmnlintrc in the project root, or bpmnlint:recommended when there is none.

configPath.description: Path to the .bpmnlintrc to use, relative to the project root.

clientBundlePath.description: A bundle of rules from bpmnlint plugins for the editor, built with bpmnlint-pack-config. Needed only when .bpmnlintrc uses a plugin; the command line reads plugins from node_modules.

conventions.description: Rules the editor applies while modelling, so a team does not have to remember them.

ids.description: How technical ids are derived from what an element is called.

fromName.description: Rewrite the id when the name changes.

pattern.description: The shape of the id. {Type} is the element type, {Name} the label in PascalCase.

defaults.description: Attributes to set on a newly created element, keyed by its BPMN type — "bpmn:ServiceTask", "bpmn:DataInput".

variables.description: How the variables a step reads are checked against the code that sets them. The Pro part needs Penstock Pro on a developer machine and Team in a pipeline; without it nothing is reported.

check.description: off; fields, which reports a field the type of a variable does not have (the default); or names, which also reports a name nothing sets and that is not an input.

inputs.description: Variables the process is started with from outside. A name listed here is not reported as set by nothing.

tests.description: Where `penstock junit` writes the tests it generates. By default each diagram gets them in its own module - the nearest folder with a Gradle or Maven build - in the language and package that module already uses.

language.description: The language of the tests. By default Kotlin if the module has Kotlin sources, otherwise Java.

out.description: The source folder the tests go to, relative to the project root. By default src/test/java or src/test/kotlin of the module.

package.description: The package of the tests. By default the package of the Spring Boot application, or the one all sources share, followed by .process.

hooks.description: Commands to run around a stage. They run in the project root with PENSTOCK_FILES and PENSTOCK_PROFILE set; a non-zero exit from a "pre" hook stops the stage.

postCheck.description: After check runs, whatever it found.

postLayout.description: After layout has written its result.

preDeploy.description: Before anything is sent. Stops the deployment if it fails.

postDeploy.description: After a successful deployment — a notification, a tag, a release note.

deployment.description: Where deploy sends the diagram. One target; a profile overrides it for another environment. Secrets are referenced with ${VAR}, never written here.

url.description: Where to deploy. The engine decides what this address means: the Camunda 7 REST API (http://localhost:8080/engine-rest) or the Camunda 8 Zeebe REST gateway.

name.description: Deployment name shown in the engine.

tenantId.description: Tenant to deploy to. Empty means the default tenant.

source.description: Deployment source recorded by the engine.

changedOnly.description: Leave out what the engine already has unchanged. On unless set to false.

forTests.description: This engine is for tests: Penstock may deploy test builds and answer jobs on it when it runs test cases.

activationTime.description: ISO timestamp the deployment becomes active.

type.description: How to authenticate against the engine. The password or client secret comes from the IDE password safe, or from PENSTOCK_PASSWORD and PENSTOCK_CLIENT_SECRET on the command line.

username.description: Basic auth user. The password lives in the IDE password safe.

clientId.description: OAuth client id. The secret lives in the IDE password safe.

profile.description: Profile to apply. PENSTOCK_PROFILE overrides this.

profiles.description: Named overrides, applied on top of the settings above when the profile is active.
